d: Are you analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in regulatory compliance and risk management? We're looking for a dedicated Compliance Officer to support regulatory monitoring, maintain compliance standards, review internal procedures, and help ensure business activities follow applicable laws and policies.
This is an excellent opportunity for a professional with strong judgment, integrity, and a passion for maintaining transparent and responsible business operations.
⚖️ Monitor internal policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
🔍 Conduct compliance reviews and support internal monitoring activities.
📋 Maintain compliance registers, regulatory records, and supporting documentation.
📑 Review business processes and identify potential compliance gaps.
🤝 Coordinate with internal departments to address compliance-related matters.
📊 Prepare compliance reports, risk assessments, and management updates.
📝 Assist with developing and updating internal policies and compliance procedures.
🔒 Support proper recordkeeping and confidential information management.
📅 Monitor regulatory developments and communicate relevant updates to management.
💡 Recommend improvements to strengthen internal controls and compliance practices.
3+ years of experience in compliance, risk management, auditing, legal administration, or a related field is preferred.
Understanding of regulatory requirements, internal controls, and compliance procedures.
Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
High attention to detail and ability to manage confidential information.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office and digital compliance systems.
Professional integrity and strong organizational skills.
Ability to work independently and coordinate compliance activities remotely.
A bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
🌍 Remote working opportunity with a Dubai-based team.
📈 Opportunities to contribute to compliance and risk management initiatives.
💡 Exposure to regulatory monitoring and business process improvement.
🚀 Opportunities for professional development and long-term career growth.
Ready to bring your compliance expertise and analytical skills to our team?
Send us your updated CV and a brief introduction highlighting your relevant experience, professional qualifications, and key strengths.
Take the next step in your compliance career — we look forward to hearing from you!
